hooks.command: bash "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/inject-core.sh" concise-core-override.md core.md 'This session runs on Windows: a command the user may paste goes in a `powershell` fence, one command per fence — `&&` is a parse error in Windows PowerShell 5.1, and `bash` typed there is the WSL stub. Give the Git Bash long form when the tool is POSIX-only.' 'This session runs on macOS: a command the user may paste goes in a `bash` fence, one per fence. BSD `sed`, `date` and `readlink` take different flags from the GNU ones — prefer the portable form.' 'This session runs on Linux: a command the user may paste goes in a `bash` fence, one command per fence.'

bash "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/notices.sh" concise "concise is on. Thirteen commands, by destination: /concise:pr, :card, :commit, :comment, :release and :handoff write what leaves the conversation; :plan, :decide, :draw and :status shape what stays in it; :rewrite retrofits a finished text, :trim cuts the dead text out of code and screens, and :audit reports its violations for :rewrite to fix. This note shows once." "concise: self-update has been failing for over a week. Run %s to see the error."

bash "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/turn-reminder.sh" 'Style concise, this turn: the answer in the first sentence; one budget for the turn, so preamble, recap, narration and the tour of what you delivered all go; in code, a comment says only what the code leaves unsaid; always keep bad news, exact values, real uncertainty and any caveat that changes what the reader does.' .concise-no-turn-reminder

bash "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/credit-guard.sh" "AI credit found in the text. Authorship of every commit, PR, issue and release belongs to the user alone - rewrite it with the user as the only author." .concise-no-credit-guard
